name: Crystal Ball of Mind Reading
summary: A crystal orb that casts Scrying and reads the thoughts of creatures near its sensor.

stats.effect: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast *{ref:spell/scrying}* (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you can cast *{ref:spell/detect-thoughts}* (save DC 17) targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You don't need to concentrate on this *{ref:spell/detect-thoughts}* spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the *{ref:spell/scrying}* spell ends.
